name: Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015
description: US federal law authorizing voluntary cyber-threat-information sharing between private sector and federal government with liability protections. **NOTE: distinct from the agency CISA (Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency)** established by the CISA Act of 2018.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by United States Federal (govinfo.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within United States Federal (govinfo.gov).
